title: DocuDrop — Download Your Receipt
objective: Download one of your own receipts normally, then use the same download feature to read a file that isn't a receipt at all.

verifier.condition: The download endpoint returns the content of a file outside the receipts directory, via a filename containing a traversal sequence.

weakness: The requested filename is concatenated directly onto the receipts directory with no normalization or containment check, so '../' sequences escape the intended directory.
seededData: A simulated filesystem (never real disk — see lab-sdk's MiniVfs) with a receipts directory and a sibling 'internal' directory holding a synthetic secrets file.
hints: Download your own receipt first and look at exactly how the filename appears in the request.
The receipts directory has at least one sibling directory. Directory structures are usually navigable from the inside.
A filename doesn't have to refer to a file IN the current directory.
burpNotes: Send the download request to Repeater and replace the file parameter with a traversal sequence leading to a sibling directory.
